chunks.text: Hello guys, welcome back to my channel Indian Kitchen Today I am going to tell you how to make Aloo Kachalo If you like my recipe, please like and subscribe to my channel First, I have boiled 4 potatoes Do not over boil the potatoes We will remove the skin of the potatoes Meanwhile, I will tell you the spices For this, we will make a special masala 1 tbsp cumin seeds 1 tbsp coriander seeds 3-4 dry red chillies 9-10 black pepper Roast the spices on a low flame Then grind it in a mixer The spices are now cool Now we will grind it in a mixer The masala is now ready Once the potatoes are cool, we will peel them After peeling, cut them into medium sized pieces Now we have cut the potatoes Now we will add the spices Red chilli powder Roasted cumin powder White salt Black salt Dry mango powder Chaat masala Mix it well Add salt as per your taste Now we will add the roasted spices I have made tamarind water I have soaked the tamarind for 15-20 minutes Then I have strained the water Now we will add 3-4 tbsp tamarind water This will give a very good flavor If you do not have this, you can add lemon juice But it will give a different taste Now we will add the green chillies Add green chillies as per your taste Mix it well Now we will add the tamarind water Our recipe is now ready If you like our recipe, please like and subscribe to our channel Thanks for watching So delicious
